parsed.post: My attempt at MATRIX_LR=0.03 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 regressed (1.0397 vs 1.0308). The previous best was actually more stable. It seems the LR curve might be flattening or I've hit a local minimum. Moving to probe ASPECT_RATIO changes or checking WEIGHT_DECAY to see if it stabilizes the lower LR.
